reason: Both attempts failed on implementation time (45 min each fully consumed building the perf table/caps, then the 1314-line render rewrite + 523-line bench driver) — the environment is fine (full suite ~118 s, nothing hangs), but the 60 s benchmark has never been run end-to-end, so the remaining work has two distinct risk pockets that should not share one iteration. TASK-58.1 runs the full verification chain for the first time and fixes only driver/tally/monitor bugs until the committed gates (no-spike, draw/material/triangle budgets, 20 % variance) exit 0 with numbers recorded — deliberately excluding the delta check so it cannot grow. TASK-58.2 verifies (or earns via the single remaining spec pass, the per-LOD-ring chunk-mesh merge) the >= 30 % delta, rewrites the perf.ts 'bench-run-1' placeholder comments with the real recorded numbers, records TASK-61's numbers, and closes out. Together they cover every unmet acceptance criterion of TASK-58; each is comfortably one iteration.
